brief.prompt: A 9-second walk through how tea gets from a Sylhet hillside to a cup, written directly as a plan with no AI in the loop, to prove the renderer before any stage that would produce one exists.

script.hook: Every cup starts on a hillside.

beats.narration: Bengal's tea gardens start on hillsides in Sylhet.
Workers pick each leaf by hand before sunrise.
The leaves are dried, rolled, and sealed for market.

script.reason: three beats — origin, harvest, processing — cover the brief's walk from hillside to cup in about nine seconds

voice.reason: no TTS provider exists yet, and this fixture exercises the renderer rather than voice generation; each beat's narration audio is a synthesized tone of the duration a human wrote by hand, standing in for a voice

b1.reason: a hillside-green colour bar, hand-picked as a placeholder — no footage provider exists yet. Exactly as long as its narration, so this beat cuts cleanly with no hold or trim

b2.reason: deliberately shorter (1.8s) than its 3.6s narration, to prove the renderer holds the last frame rather than cutting away mid-sentence

b3.reason: deliberately longer (5.0s) than its 2.4s narration, to prove the renderer trims the clip rather than overrunning into the next beat

align.reason: word timings written by hand against each synthesized narration tone's duration, standing in for an aligner that does not exist yet

captions.reason: three words at a time stays readable at 1080px wide on a phone screen; white text with a black outline reads over any background colour

music.reason: a synthesized tone stands in for a music bed, added specifically to exercise ducking under the narration — no music provider exists yet
